prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, inside a small 1930s shop full of loaves, seen over the shoulder of a fat gangster with a scar through his top lip in a white apron behind the wooden counter: across the counter, a heavy-set Black baker in his fifties with a shaved head, a broken nose and a double chin, in a sweat-stained vest and apron tips his whole thin brown pay envelope out onto the counter, a small heap of coins, for one small loaf, his real-skinned face tired and resigned. On the wall above the counter, a big blank black chalkboard with nothing written on it, smeared with old chalk dust. Warm lamplight on the shelves of loaves; cold blue night in the window behind the baker. Most of the frame in warm shadow; the brightest values are the coins and the loaf under the lamp. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
